name: IEC3D-AD: Industrial Equipment Components 3D Anomaly Detection Dataset (OpenIndustry)
description: Industrial 3D point cloud anomaly detection dataset (IEC3D-AD / OpenIndustry) comprising 2,400 high-fidelity 360-degree point cloud scans across 15 real industrial equipment component categories (bearings, bolts, rings, nuts, and studs). Captured via structured-light 3D scanning, each category provides 100 normal training scans and 60 test scans featuring five authentic production defect types (bump, deformation, dent, scar, and scratch) for unsupervised and open-set anomaly detection.

provenance.collection_method: Multi-view structured light scanning system generating complete 360-degree point clouds of manufactured mechanical parts with average density of ~160k points per scan.
provenance.curation_notes: The underlying physical dataset is IEC3D-AD (Industrial Equipment Components 3D Anomaly Detection) containing 2,400 scans across 15 component categories (100 normal training, 60 test per category). OpenIndustry represents the open-set benchmark distribution derived from these exact 2,400 point cloud scans.
